duas.title: Talbiyah
duas.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
duas.transliteration: Labbayk Allāhumma labbayk. Labbayk lā sharīka laka labbayk. Innal-ḥamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk. Lā sharīka lak.
duas.translation: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise, grace, and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.
duas.when_to_recite: From the moment of entering Ihram until throwing the first stone at Jamarat al-Aqabah on the 10th of Dhul Hijjah
duas.notes: Recite loudly — it is Sunnah for men to raise their voices. Women recite quietly.

duas.title: Intention for Hajj
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ الْحَجَّ فَيَسِّرْهُ لِي وَتَقَبَّلْهُ مِنِّي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī urīdul-ḥajja fayassirhu lī wa taqabbalhu minnī.
duas.translation: O Allah, I intend to perform Hajj, so make it easy for me and accept it from me.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon putting on the Ihram garments and making the intention
duas.source: Authenticated by scholars of Hajj fiqh
duas.notes: The intention is in the heart; verbal expression is recommended.

duas.title: Du'a at the Start of Tawaf
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ إِيمَانًا بِكَ وَتَصْدِيقًا بِكِتَابِكَ وَوَفَاءً بِعَهْدِكَ وَاتِّبَاعًا لِسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ
duas.transliteration: Bismillāhi wallāhu akbar. Allāhumma īmānan bika wa taṣdīqan bikitābika wa wafā'an bi'ahdika wattibā'an lisunnati nabiyyika Muḥammadin ﷺ.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah and Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, [I begin this tawaf] with faith in You, affirming Your Book, fulfilling Your covenant, and following the Sunnah of Your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon reaching the Black Stone and beginning each circuit of Tawaf
duas.notes: Touch or kiss the Black Stone if possible, otherwise point toward it.

duas.title: Du'a at the Black Stone (Hajar al-Aswad)
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillāhi wallāhu akbar.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
duas.when_to_recite: Each time you pass the Black Stone during Tawaf
duas.notes: If you cannot touch the Black Stone due to crowds, simply point toward it and say this du'a.

duas.title: Du'a at the Yemeni Corner
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fil-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā 'adhāban-nār.
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.when_to_recite: Between the Yemeni Corner (Rukn al-Yamani) and the Black Stone during Tawaf
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ recited this du'a in every circuit between these two corners.

duas.title: Du'a at Maqam Ibrahim
duas.arabic: وَاتَّخِذُوا مِن مَّقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى
duas.transliteration: Wattakhidhū min maqāmi Ibrāhīma muṣallā.
duas.translation: And take the station of Ibrahim as a place of prayer.
duas.when_to_recite: After completing 7 circuits of Tawaf, before praying 2 rakaat at Maqam Ibrahim
duas.notes: Pray 2 rakaat behind Maqam Ibrahim after every Tawaf.

duas.title: Du'a at Safa
duas.arabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ، أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ. اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ. لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Innaṣ-ṣafā wal-marwata min sha'ā'irillāh. Abd'au bimā bada'allāhu bih. Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar. Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-ḥamdu wahuwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr.
duas.translation: Indeed, Safa and Marwa are among the symbols of Allah. I begin with what Allah began with. Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs sovereignty and praise, and He has power over everything.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon climbing Safa at the beginning of each Sa'i and while facing the Qiblah
duas.notes: Raise your hands in du'a after reciting this and make any supplication you wish.

duas.title: Best Du'a of Arafat
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-ḥamdu wahuwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr.
duas.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs sovereignty and praise, and He has power over everything.
duas.when_to_recite: Throughout the standing at Arafat — repeat abundantly
duas.notes: This is the most virtuous dhikr to repeat at Arafat. Combine it with personal du'a in your own language.

duas.title: Comprehensive Du'a for Arafat
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تَسْمَعُ كَلَامِي، وَتَرَى مَكَانِي، وَتَعْلَمُ سِرِّي وَعَلَانِيَتِي، لَا يَخْفَى عَلَيْكَ شَيْءٌ مِنْ أَمْرِي. أَنَا الْبَائِسُ الْفَقِيرُ، الْمُسْتَغِيثُ الْمُسْتَجِيرُ، الْوَجِلُ الْمُشْفِقُ. أَسْأَلُكَ مَسْأَلَةَ الْمِسْكِينِ، وَأَبْتَهِلُ إِلَيْكَ ابْتِهَالَ الْمُذْنِبِ الذَّلِيلِ، وَأَدْعُوكَ دُعَاءَ الْخَائِفِ الضَّرِيرِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innaka tasma'u kalāmī, wa tarā makānī, wa ta'lamu sirrī wa 'alāniyatī, lā yakhfā 'alayka shay'un min amrī. Anal-bā'isul-faqīr, al-mustaghīthul-mustajīr, al-wajilul-mushfiq. As'aluka mas'alatal-miskīn, wa abtahilu ilayka ibtihālal-mudhnibidh-dhalīl, wa ad'ūka du'ā'al-khā'ifidh-dharīr.
duas.translation: O Allah, You hear my words, You see my situation, You know my hidden and open affairs — nothing of my matter is hidden from You. I am wretched and poor, seeking Your help and refuge, fearful and anxious. I ask You with the asking of the destitute, I plead to You with the pleading of the humbled sinner, and I call upon You with the supplication of the fearful afflicted.
duas.when_to_recite: At Arafat during the wuquf
duas.notes: Follow this with personal du'a for yourself, your family, and the ummah.

duas.title: Du'a upon Arriving at Muzdalifah
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذِهِ مُزْدَلِفَةُ جُمِعَتْ فِيهَا أَلْسِنَةٌ شَتَّى تَسْأَلُكَ حَوَائِجَ شَتَّى، فَاجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنْ إِذَا سَأَلَكَ الْجَنَّةَ أَعْطَيْتَهُ، وَإِذَا تَعَوَّذَ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ أَعَذْتَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma inna hādhihi Muzdalifatu jumi'at fīhā alsina shattā tas'aluka ḥawā'ija shattā, faj'alnī mimman idhā sa'alaka al-jannata a'ṭaytahu, wa idhā ta'awwadha bika minan-nāri a'adhtahu.
duas.translation: O Allah, in Muzdalifah many tongues are gathered, each asking You for different needs. Make me among those whom when they ask You for Paradise, You grant it, and when they seek refuge with You from the Fire, You protect them.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon arriving at Muzdalifah
duas.source: From the supplications of the pious predecessors
duas.notes: Pray Maghrib and Isha combined and shortened upon arrival.

duas.title: Du'a when Throwing Each Pebble
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhu akbar.
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest.
duas.when_to_recite: With each of the 7 pebbles thrown at the Jamarat
duas.notes: After stoning the Jamarat al-Sughra and al-Wusta, face the Qiblah and raise your hands in du'a. No du'a after the Aqabah.

duas.title: Du'a for Animal Sacrifice
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ هَذَا مِنْكَ وَلَكَ، اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
duas.transliteration: Bismillāhi wallāhu akbar. Allāhumma hādhā minka wa lak. Allāhumma taqabbal minnī.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, this is from You and for You. O Allah, accept it from me.
duas.when_to_recite: When performing or witnessing the animal sacrifice
duas.notes: If a proxy is performing the sacrifice, they recite this on your behalf.

duas.title: Du'a for Farewell Tawaf
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ الْبَيْتُ بَيْتُكَ وَالْعَبْدُ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، حَمَلْتَنِي عَلَى مَا سَخَّرْتَ لِي مِنْ خَلْقِكَ حَتَّى سَيَّرْتَنِي فِي بِلَادِكَ وَبَلَّغْتَنِي بِنِعْمَتِكَ حَتَّى أَعَنْتَنِي عَلَى قَضَاءِ مَنَاسِكِكَ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ رَضِيتَ عَنِّي فَازْدَدْ عَنِّي رِضًا، وَإِلَّا فَمِنَ الْآنَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْأَى عَنْ بَيْتِكَ دَارِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma al-baytu baytuka wal-'abdu 'abduka wabnu 'abdika wabnu amatik. Ḥamaltanī 'alā mā sakhkharta lī min khalqika ḥattā sayyartanī fī bilādika wa ballaghtanī bini'matika ḥattā a'antanī 'alā qaḍā'i manāsikik. Fa in kunta raḍīta 'annī faz'dad 'annī riḍan, wa illā faminal-āna qabla an tan'ā 'an baytika dārī.
duas.translation: O Allah, this House is Your House, and I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your female servant. You carried me on what You have placed in service for me of Your creation, until You made me travel through Your lands and conveyed me through Your blessing until You helped me complete the rituals. If You are pleased with me, increase Your pleasure in me; otherwise, from now, before my home grows distant from Your House.
duas.when_to_recite: During the Farewell Tawaf
duas.notes: This is a deeply moving du'a. Many pilgrims weep during the Farewell Tawaf.

duas.title: Du'a when Drinking Zamzam
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا وَاسِعًا وَشِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka 'ilman nāfi'an wa rizqan wāsi'an wa shifā'an min kulli dā'.
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, abundant provision, and cure from every illness.
duas.when_to_recite: When drinking Zamzam water
duas.notes: Drink Zamzam while standing, facing the Qiblah, with three breaths.

duas.title: Du'a Entering the Masjid
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma iftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik.
duas.translation: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon entering any masjid, especially Masjid al-Haram
duas.notes: Enter with your right foot first.

duas.title: Du'a Leaving the Masjid
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka min faḍlik.
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon leaving any masjid
duas.notes: Exit with your left foot first.

duas.title: Du'a upon First Seeing the Kaaba
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ زِدْ هَذَا الْبَيْتَ تَشْرِيفًا وَتَعْظِيمًا وَتَكْرِيمًا وَمَهَابَةً، وَزِدْ مَنْ شَرَّفَهُ وَعَظَّمَهُ مِمَّنْ حَجَّهُ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَهُ تَشْرِيفًا وَتَكْرِيمًا وَتَعْظِيمًا وَبِرًّا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma zid hādhal-bayta tashrīfan wa ta'ẓīman wa takrīman wa mahābah. Wa zid man sharrafahu wa 'aẓẓamahu mimman ḥajjahu awi'tamarahu tashrīfan wa takrīman wa ta'ẓīman wa birrā.
duas.translation: O Allah, increase this House in honor, reverence, dignity, and awe. And increase in honor, dignity, reverence, and piety those who honor and revere it among those who perform Hajj or Umrah.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon first beholding the Kaaba
duas.notes: The sight of the Kaaba is a moment of answered prayers. Raise your hands and make personal du'a.

duas.title: Salawat Ibrahim (Durood Ibrahim)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli 'alā Muḥammadin wa 'alā āli Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta 'alā Ibrāhīma wa 'alā āli Ibrāhīma innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd. Allāhumma bārik 'alā Muḥammadin wa 'alā āli Muḥammadin kamā bārakta 'alā Ibrāhīma wa 'alā āli Ibrāhīma innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.
duas.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim. You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious.
duas.when_to_recite: In prayer and throughout Hajj, especially near Maqam Ibrahim
duas.notes: Sending salawat on the Prophet ﷺ is highly virtuous throughout Hajj.

duas.title: Istighfar — Seeking Forgiveness
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullāhal-'aẓīmallladhī lā ilāha illā huwal-Ḥayyul-Qayyūmu wa atūbu ilayh.
duas.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah, the Mighty, other than whom there is no God, the Living, the Sustaining, and I repent to Him.
duas.when_to_recite: Abundantly throughout Hajj, especially at Arafat and in Mina
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever says this, Allah will forgive him even if he fled from battle.'

duas.title: Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.transliteration: Subḥānallāhi walḥamdu lillāhi wa lā ilāha illallāhu wallāhu akbar.
duas.translation: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
duas.when_to_recite: Constantly throughout Hajj — walking, waiting, resting
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ said these four words are the most beloved speech to Allah.

duas.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar (Master of Forgiveness)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā ant, khalaqtanī wa anā 'abduk, wa anā 'alā 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'ūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣana't, abū'u laka bini'matika 'alayy, wa abū'u bidhanbī faghfir lī, fa'innahu lā yaghfirudhdhunūba illā ant.
duas.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessing upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me — for indeed no one forgives sins except You.
duas.when_to_recite: Morning and evening — especially at Arafat, Mina, and Muzdalifah. The Prophet ﷺ called this the greatest prayer of forgiveness.
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever recites this with certainty in the morning and dies that day before evening will enter Paradise. Likewise for evening.'

duas.title: Du'a for Complete Forgiveness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lī mā qaddamtu wa mā akhkhartu wa mā asrartu wa mā a'lantu wa mā anta a'lamu bihi minnī, antal-muqaddimu wa antal-mu'akhkhiru wa anta 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr.
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me for what I have done before and what I have left for later, what I have hidden and what I have made public, and what You know better than I do. You are the One who advances and the One who delays, and You have power over all things.
duas.when_to_recite: In the night prayer (Tahajjud) and at Arafat — covers all categories of sins
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ recited this in his night prayer (Qiyam al-Layl). An all-encompassing prayer for forgiveness.

duas.title: Du'a of Sincere Repentance
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي وَجَهْلِي، وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي. اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي جِدِّي وَهَزْلِي، وَخَطَئِي وَعَمْدِي، وَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ عِنْدِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lī khaṭī'atī wa jahlī, wa isrāfī fī amrī, wa mā anta a'lamu bihi minnī. Allāhummaghfir lī jiddī wa hazlī, wa khaṭa'ī wa 'amdī, wa kullu dhālika 'indī.
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me my error, my ignorance, my immoderation in my affairs, and what You know better than I. O Allah, forgive me my earnest and my jest, my mistake and my intentional wrongdoing — all of that is within me.
duas.when_to_recite: During Hajj, especially after committing any error or lapse in worship
duas.notes: Covers both intentional and unintentional sins, serious and trivial. Hajj is a time for true repentance.

duas.title: Du'a for a Good Ending (Husnul Khatimah)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ خَيْرَ عُمُرِي آخِرَهُ، وَخَيْرَ عَمَلِي خَوَاتِمَهُ، وَخَيْرَ أَيَّامِي يَوْمَ أَلْقَاكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ij'al khayra 'umurī ākhirah, wa khayra 'amalī khawātimahu, wa khayra ayyāmī yawma alqāk.
duas.translation: O Allah, make the best of my life its last part, make the best of my deeds their conclusion, and make the best of my days the day I meet You.
duas.when_to_recite: At Arafat, during Tawaf, and in personal supplication throughout Hajj
duas.notes: Ask Allah that your Hajj be the final act that seals your life with goodness and that your faith grows until death.

duas.title: Du'a for Healing (Shifa)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، وَاشْفِ، أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma rabban-nās, adhhibilba's, washfi, antash-shāfī, lā shifā'a illā shifā'uk, shifā'an lā yughādiru saqamā.
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the affliction and heal — You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness behind.
duas.when_to_recite: During Hajj when sick or in discomfort — also recite over Zamzam water before drinking
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ recited this when visiting the sick. Zamzam water with this du'a is a Sunnah remedy.

duas.title: Du'a for Full Bodily Health (Aafiya)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma 'āfinī fī badanī. Allāhumma 'āfinī fī sam'ī. Allāhumma 'āfinī fī baṣarī. Lā ilāha illā ant.
duas.translation: O Allah, grant me health in my body. O Allah, grant me health in my hearing. O Allah, grant me health in my sight. There is no god but You.
duas.when_to_recite: Morning and evening — and during Hajj when fatigued or unwell
duas.notes: A companion asked the Prophet ﷺ what du'a to make — he was taught to ask for 'aafiya (comprehensive well-being) above all else.

duas.title: Du'a for Protection from Disease
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ وَالْجُنُونِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-barasi wal-junūni wal-judhāmi wa min sayyi'il-asqām.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from skin disease, insanity, leprosy, and from all evil illnesses.
duas.when_to_recite: During the Hajj season when in crowded places — morning and evening for protection
duas.notes: Hajj involves large crowds in heat. Seek Allah's protection from illness every morning and evening.

duas.title: Du'a for Patience and Endurance
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُكَلِّفْنِي مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لِي بِهِ، وَاجْعَلْ فِيمَا ابْتَلَيْتَنِي بِهِ خَيْرًا لِي، وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْهُ فَرَجًا وَمَخْرَجًا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma lā tukallifnī mā lā ṭāqata lī bih, waj'al fīmabtalaytan bihi khayran lī, waj'al lī minhu farajan wa makhrajā.
duas.translation: O Allah, do not burden me with what I cannot bear. Make that which You have tested me with a source of good for me, and grant me relief and a way out from it.
duas.when_to_recite: During the physical hardships of Hajj — extreme heat, crowds, long walks, fatigue
duas.notes: Hajj is physically demanding. Ask Allah to make the hardship a means of purification and reward.

duas.title: Du'a for Righteous Children
duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab lī minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
duas.translation: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous.
duas.when_to_recite: Throughout Hajj — especially at Arafat, during Tawaf, and when drinking Zamzam
duas.source: Quran 37:100 — Du'a of Prophet Ibrahim ﷺ
duas.notes: Prophet Ibrahim ﷺ made this du'a and was blessed with Ismail ﷺ. Hajj connects us to this blessed lineage.

duas.title: Du'a for a Righteous Family
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wa dhurriyyātinā qurrata a'yunin waj'alnā lil-muttaqīna imāmā.
duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and offspring the coolness of our eyes, and make us leaders for the righteous.
duas.when_to_recite: Especially at Arafat and during Sa'i — ask for a righteous spouse and children who are coolness to your eyes
duas.notes: One of the most beautiful Quranic du'as. Ask Allah to make your family the joy and peace of your heart.

duas.title: Du'a for Parents and Believers
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lī wa liwālidayya wa liman dakhala baytī mu'minan wa lil-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināt.
duas.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my home as a believer, and all believing men and believing women.
duas.when_to_recite: Every day during Hajj — parents often cannot make Hajj themselves; make du'a for them
duas.source: Quran 71:28 — Du'a of Prophet Nuh ﷺ
duas.notes: If your parents are alive, Hajj is the perfect time to ask Allah to forgive them and bless them. If they have passed, their du'a continues to reach them.

duas.title: Du'a for Children Who Pray
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ij'alnī muqīmaṣ-ṣalāti wa min dhurriyyatī. Rabbanā wa taqabbal du'ā'.
duas.translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
duas.when_to_recite: Ask at every Salah during Hajj — pray that your children and grandchildren are constant in their prayers
duas.source: Quran 14:40 — Du'a of Prophet Ibrahim ﷺ
duas.notes: Standing near the Maqam Ibrahim during Hajj is a powerful moment to ask Allah to make your offspring people of prayer.

duas.title: Du'a for Gratitude and Righteous Deeds for Family
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nī an ashkura ni'matakallātī an'amta 'alayya wa 'alā wālidayya wa an a'mala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa aṣliḥ lī fī dhurriyyatī.
duas.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do good deeds that please You, and make righteous for me my offspring.
duas.when_to_recite: At Arafat and throughout Hajj — especially if you have children or are expecting
duas.notes: This du'a encompasses gratitude, righteous action, and a prayer for your children all in one. A comprehensive family supplication.

duas.title: Du'a for Lawful Provision and Sufficiency
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma akfinī biḥalālika 'an ḥarāmika, wa aghnini bifaḍlika 'amman siwāk.
duas.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful against what You have made forbidden, and enrich me by Your grace to the exclusion of all others.
duas.when_to_recite: During Hajj and as a daily du'a — especially when asking for business success or financial stability
duas.notes: Ask Allah to make halal sustenance your source of wealth and to free you from dependence on anyone other than Him.

duas.title: Du'a for Guidance, Piety, and Contentment
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'alukal-hudā wat-tuqā wal-'afāfa wal-ghinā.
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and contentment.
duas.when_to_recite: Abundantly at Arafat and in Mina — a simple yet powerful supplication taught by the Prophet ﷺ
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ taught this supplication as a comprehensive request covering all spiritual and worldly needs.

duas.title: Du'a for Relief from Difficulty
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā ja'altahu sahlā, wa anta taj'alul-ḥazna idhā shi'ta sahlā.
duas.translation: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You can make the difficult easy if You will.
duas.when_to_recite: Whenever facing any difficulty during Hajj — logistical, physical, or emotional
duas.notes: Repeat this during any difficult moment of Hajj — crowds, fatigue, confusion. Allah makes all things easy.

duas.title: Du'a for Divine Guidance and Success (Tawfiq)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلْهِمْنِي رُشْدِي، وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma alhimnī rushdī, wa a'idhnī min sharri nafsī.
duas.translation: O Allah, inspire me with right guidance and protect me from the evil of my own soul.
duas.when_to_recite: When making important decisions — career, marriage, business, studies — ask this at Arafat
duas.notes: Our own ego and desires are often the greatest obstacles to success. Ask Allah to guide you and protect you from yourself.

duas.title: Du'a for Barakah in Wealth and Sustenance
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīmā razaqtanā wa qinā 'adhāban-nār.
duas.translation: O Allah, bless us in what You have provided us and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.when_to_recite: After every meal and when asking for barakah in income, projects, and work
duas.notes: Barakah (divine blessing) in wealth means small amounts go far and bring happiness. Ask for this rather than just more money.

duas.title: Du'a for Relief from Anxiety and Debt
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-hammi wal-ḥazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa ḍala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijāl.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, and from the burden of debt and the oppression of people.
duas.when_to_recite: If burdened by debt, financial stress, anxiety, or worry — repeat abundantly at Arafat
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ recited this regularly. Hajj is the perfect occasion to ask Allah to lift these burdens from your life.

duas.title: Salat al-Janaza — Main Du'a
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lahu warḥamhu wa ʿāfihi waʿfu ʿanhu wa akrim nuzulahu wa wassiʿ mudkhalahu waghsilhu bil-māʾi wath-thalji wal-barad, wa naqqihi minal-khaṭāyā kamā naqqayta-th-thawbal-abyaḍa minad-danas, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārihi wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi wa zawjan khayran min zawjihi wa adkhilhul-jannata wa aʿidhhu min ʿadhābil-qabri wa min ʿadhābin-nār.
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, give him health and pardon him, be generous to him, grant him a spacious dwelling and wash him with water, snow and hail. Purify him from sins as a white garment is purified from filth. Give him an abode better than his home, a family better than his family, a spouse better than his spouse. Admit him into Paradise and protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the Fire.
duas.when_to_recite: After the 3rd Takbeer in Salat al-Janaza. Change لَهُ → لَهَا (for female) or لَهُمْ (for group).
duas.notes: ★ Janaza prayers are performed daily after Fajr at Masjid al-Haram (Makkah) and Masjid al-Nabawi (Madinah). The Prophet ﷺ said praying Janaza earns one Qirat of reward (like Mount Uhud) — attending to burial earns two. One of the greatest blessings of being at these holy sites.

duas.title: Du'a for All Muslims — Living and Deceased
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا، اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الإِسْلَامِ وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir liḥayyinā wa mayyitinā wa shāhidinā wa ghāʾibinā wa ṣaghīrinā wa kabīrinā wa dhakarinā wa unthānā. Allāhumma man aḥyaytahu minnā fa-aḥyihi ʿalal-islām wa man tawaffaytahu minnā fatawaffahu ʿalal-īmān.
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whoever among us You keep alive, keep them upon Islam; and whoever among us You cause to die, let them die upon faith.
duas.when_to_recite: Also recited in Janaza prayer (after 3rd Takbeer). Recite at Arafat for all deceased family members.
duas.notes: A comprehensive dua covering every Muslim who has ever lived. Short enough to memorize, powerful enough to cover all.

duas.title: Du'a for Deceased Parents
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lī wa liwālidayya warḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīrā.
duas.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents, and have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.
duas.when_to_recite: Recite especially at Arafat, during Tawaf, and when drinking Zamzam — even if your parents have passed, this dua reaches them.
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ said a righteous child's dua is one of the three deeds that continues to benefit the deceased after death.

duas.title: Du'a for All Deceased Muslims
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ الأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالأَمْوَاتِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lil-muslimīna wal-muslimāti wal-muʾminīna wal-muʾmināti al-aḥyāʾi minhum wal-amwāt.
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive the Muslim men and Muslim women, the believing men and believing women, both the living and the dead.
duas.when_to_recite: Recite abundantly at Arafat — cover every Muslim who has ever lived in one short supplication.
duas.source: Authenticated — recommended by scholars of hadith
duas.notes: Short but sweeping. Three seconds to cover every Muslim who has passed. Repeat this many times at Arafat.

duas.title: Du'a when Visiting Graves (Baqi / Mualla)
duas.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
duas.transliteration: As-salāmu ʿalaykum ahlad-diyāri minal-muʾminīna wal-muslimīn. Wa innā in shāʾallāhu bikum lāḥiqūn. Asʾalullāha lanā wa lakumul-ʿāfiyah.
duas.translation: Peace be upon you, O people of these dwellings, from among the believers and Muslims. We will, if Allah wills, join you. I ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.
duas.when_to_recite: When visiting Jannatul Baqi (Madinah) where many companions are buried, and Jannatul Mualla (Makkah) where Khadijah RA and other family of the Prophet ﷺ are buried.
duas.notes: Pilgrims visiting Madinah should visit Jannatul Baqi — Abu Bakr, Uthman, Hasan ibn Ali, and thousands of companions are buried there.

duas.title: Du'a for a Righteous Spouse — Musa ﷺ's Prayer
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr.
duas.translation: My Lord, I am truly in need of whatever good You send down to me.
duas.when_to_recite: For those seeking marriage — recite at Arafat, during Tawaf, and when drinking Zamzam. Make your need known to Allah in your own words after this.
duas.notes: Prophet Musa ﷺ made this dua alone, poor, and far from home — and Allah arranged his marriage shortly after. One of the most beautiful duas for those seeking a spouse.

duas.title: Du'a for Blessings on a Married Couple
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
duas.transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka wa bāraka ʿalayka wa jamaʿa baynakumā fī khayr.
duas.translation: May Allah bless you, send blessings upon you, and bring you both together in goodness.
duas.when_to_recite: For newly married couples — children, siblings, relatives, friends. Say this as a gift at any wedding or Nikah.
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ's own dua for newlyweds. Recite this at Arafat for every married couple you know — it is a gift of dua that reaches them.

duas.title: Du'a for Protection and Blessings in Marriage
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma jannibnash-shayṭāna wa jannibish-shayṭāna mā razaqtanā.
duas.translation: O Allah, keep Shaytan away from us, and keep Shaytan away from what You have blessed us with.
duas.when_to_recite: For spouses — recite for the protection of your marriage. Also recited at the start of marital relations and when a child is born.
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'If any of you, when coming to his wife, says this dua, and a child is conceived, Shaytan will never be able to harm that child.'

duas.title: Du'a for Protection from the Evil Eye
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bikalimātillāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of all that He has created.
duas.when_to_recite: Recite 3 times every evening. Also recite over children and loved ones for their protection.
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Nothing will harm the person who says this 3 times in the evening.' The evil eye is real — protection is a Sunnah.

duas.title: Morning & Evening Protection
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillāhil-ladhī lā yaḍurru maʿasmihi shayʾun fil-arḍi wa lā fis-samāʾi wa huwas-samīʿul-ʿalīm.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, with Whose name nothing is harmed on earth or in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
duas.when_to_recite: 3 times every morning and evening throughout Hajj — especially important in the large, physically demanding crowds.
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever says this 3 times in the morning and evening, nothing will harm him.' A key protection practice during Hajj.

duas.title: Du'a for Trust in Allah — Complete Reliance
duas.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Ḥasbiyallāhu lā ilāha illā huwa, ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul-ʿarshil-ʿaẓīm.
duas.translation: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him. In Him I have placed my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
duas.when_to_recite: 7 times every morning and evening. Especially during moments of fear, uncertainty, or when feeling overwhelmed during Hajj.
duas.notes: Reciting 7 times morning and evening is recommended. Pure tawakkul in one verse — when the crowds, heat, or exhaustion feels too much.

duas.title: Du'a for Protection from All Directions
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhummah-faẓnī min bayni yadayya wa min khalfī wa ʿan yamīnī wa ʿan shimālī wa min fawqī wa aʿūdhu biʿaẓamatika an ughtāla min taḥtī.
duas.translation: O Allah, protect me from my front and behind, from my right and left, and from above. And I seek refuge in Your Greatness from being seized from below.
duas.when_to_recite: In the morning — covers all directions of potential harm. Especially relevant during Hajj's dense crowds.
duas.notes: Comprehensive protective dua covering all directions. The Prophet ﷺ taught this as part of the morning remembrances.

duas.title: Du'a for Oppressed Muslims Worldwide
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْصُرِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ فِي كُلِّ مَكَانٍ، اللَّهُمَّ فُكَّ أَسْرَهُمْ وَارْفَعْ ضَيْمَهُمْ وَاكْشِفْ كُرْبَتَهُمْ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma-nṣuril-muslimīnal-mustaḍʿafīna fī kulli makān. Allāhumma fukka asrahum warfaʿ ḍaymahum wakshif kurbatahum.
duas.translation: O Allah, give victory to the oppressed Muslims everywhere. O Allah, free their captives, lift the oppression from them, and remove their afflictions.
duas.when_to_recite: Arafat is the greatest day — 2 million Muslims gathered together — the perfect moment to ask for all suffering Muslims worldwide.
duas.source: From duas of the scholars — widely authenticated
duas.notes: Hajj is the annual congress of the Ummah. No gathering on earth is larger. Make the most of it for all your brothers and sisters who suffer.

duas.title: Du'a for Unity of the Muslim Ummah
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا وَأَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma aṣliḥ dhāta bayninā wa allif bayna qulūbinā wahdanā subulas-salām.
duas.translation: O Allah, set right our mutual affairs, unite our hearts, and guide us to the paths of peace.
duas.when_to_recite: Throughout Hajj — especially at Arafat where pilgrims from every nation stand together as one.
duas.notes: Hajj itself is a living symbol of Muslim unity. At Arafat, you stand with Indonesians, Nigerians, Moroccans, Pakistanis as one Ummah. Ask Allah to make this real.

duas.title: Du'a for Patience and Victory — Dawud ﷺ's Army
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran wa thabbit aqdāmanā wanṣurnā ʿalal-qawmil-kāfirīn.
duas.translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
duas.when_to_recite: For all Muslims facing oppression, injustice, and hardship worldwide. Recite at Arafat with full conviction.
duas.notes: The dua of Prophet Dawud's soldiers before facing Goliath. Dawud killed Goliath shortly after. A dua of steadfastness and ultimate victory.

duas.title: Du'a for Righteous Muslim Leaders
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَلِّ عَلَيْنَا خِيَارَنَا وَلَا تُوَلِّ عَلَيْنَا شِرَارَنَا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma walli ʿalaynā khiyāranā wa lā tuwalli ʿalaynā shirāranā.
duas.translation: O Allah, put in charge of us the best among us, and do not put in charge of us the worst among us.
duas.when_to_recite: For Muslim-majority countries and all positions of leadership in the Ummah. Make this abundantly at Arafat.
duas.notes: Righteous leadership brings justice, prosperity, and dignity to the Ummah. Unjust leadership brings suffering. This short dua has enormous implications.

duas.title: Du'a of Ibrahim ﷺ — Accept From Us
duas.title_ar: دعاء إبراهيم عليه السلام — تقبل منا
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā taqabbal minnā innaka antas-samīʿul-ʿalīm.
duas.translation: Our Lord, accept from us. Indeed, You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
duas.when_to_recite: The single most fitting dua for Hajj — Ibrahim and Ismail made this while building the very Kaaba you circumambulate. Recite constantly.
duas.notes: Five words. Ibrahim ﷺ made this while laying the foundations of the Kaaba — the same place you now stand. Nothing is more fitting.

duas.title: Du'a for an Accepted Hajj (Mabroor)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ حَجًّا مَبْرُورًا وَسَعْيًا مَشْكُورًا وَذَنْبًا مَغْفُورًا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ajʿalhu ḥajjan mabrūran wa saʿyan mashkūran wa dhanban maghfūrā.
duas.translation: O Allah, make it an accepted Hajj, a rewarded effort, and a forgiven sin.
duas.when_to_recite: Recite throughout Hajj — from the moment of Ihram until the Farewell Tawaf.
duas.source: Traditional supplications of Hajj — widely cited by scholars
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'An accepted Hajj has no reward except Paradise.' (Sahih Bukhari 1773). Ask Allah to make this the Hajj that qualifies.

duas.title: Du'a for Laylatul Qadr and All Sacred Nights
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innaka ʿafuwwun tuḥibbul-ʿafwa faʿfu ʿannī.
duas.translation: O Allah, You are the Pardoner. You love to pardon, so pardon me.
duas.when_to_recite: The nights of Dhul Hijjah carry great virtue — recite this especially at night in Mina, Muzdalifah, and Masjid al-Haram.
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ taught this specifically for Laylatul Qadr when Aisha RA asked what to say. Memorize it — three words of Arabic that could change everything.

duas.title: Istikhara — Du'a for Guidance in Decisions
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِي الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī astakhīruka biʿilmika wa astaqdiruka biqudratika wa asʾaluka min faḍlikal-ʿaẓīm. Fa-innaka taqdiru wa lā aqdiru wa taʿlamu wa lā aʿlamu wa anta ʿallāmul-ghuyūb. Allāhumma in kunta taʿlamu anna hādhal-amra khayrun lī fī dīnī wa maʿāshī wa ʿāqibati amrī faqdurhū lī wa yassirhu lī thumma bārik lī fīh. Wa in kunta taʿlamu anna hādhal-amra sharrun lī fī dīnī wa maʿāshī wa ʿāqibati amrī faṣrifhu ʿannī waṣrifnī ʿanhu waqdur liyal-khayra ḥaythu kāna thumma arḍinī bih.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek Your guidance through Your knowledge, and Your help through Your power, and I ask of Your great bounty. You are capable and I am not; You know and I do not; and You know the unseen. O Allah, if You know this matter is good for me in my religion, worldly life, and ultimate end — decree it and make it easy, then bless me in it. If it is bad for me, divert it from me and divert me from it, and decree for me what is good wherever it may be, then make me content with it.
duas.when_to_recite: Recite after 2 rakaat of voluntary prayer when facing any major decision: marriage, career, migration, business. Hajj is the ideal time to seek guidance.
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ said he taught this for all decisions as he taught Quran. In Masjid al-Haram, prayers are 100,000× more rewarded — the ideal place for Istikhara.

duas.title: Du'a for Increase in Knowledge
duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidnī ʿilmā.
duas.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
duas.when_to_recite: Recite throughout Hajj — for yourself, your children, students, and all seeking knowledge.
duas.notes: The only place in the Quran where Allah commands the Prophet ﷺ to ask for an increase of something worldly. Three words that open every door of learning.

duas.title: Du'a for Open Heart, Clear Speech & Ease — Musa ﷺ
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbi shraḥ lī ṣadrī wa yassir lī amrī wa aḥlul ʿuqdatan min lisānī yafqahū qawlī.
duas.translation: My Lord, expand my chest, ease my task, and untie the knot from my tongue so that they may understand my speech.
duas.when_to_recite: Before any exam, important conversation, teaching, or challenge. Recite at Arafat for your children's education and careers.
duas.notes: Musa ﷺ made this dua before speaking to Pharaoh — the most powerful king on earth. Allah granted it. Recite before any daunting task.

duas.title: Du'a for Protection from Useless Knowledge
duas.title_ar: دعاء الحماية من العلم غير النافع
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دُعَاءٍ لَا يُسْمَعُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min ʿilmin lā yanfaʿ wa min qalbin lā yakhshaʿ wa min nafsin lā tashbaʿ wa min duʿāʾin lā yusmaʿ.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that is not beneficial, from a heart that does not fear, from a soul that is not satisfied, and from a supplication that is not heard.
duas.when_to_recite: Recite morning and evening during Hajj. A comprehensive dua for genuine, beneficial knowledge and a humble, attentive heart.
duas.notes: The Prophet ﷺ recited this regularly. Four things that destroy a person — useless knowledge, a hard heart, endless greed, and unheard prayers. Seek refuge from all four.
